cards.text: This one starts after a heavy loss, friend. Two sons of Aaron, Israel's high priest, died when they approached the presence of the LORD. After that, the LORD speaks to Moses, Aaron's brother and Israel's leader, with a message for Aaron.

cards.question: The LORD says Aaron must not enter freely into the Most Holy Place behind the veil. What does He say would happen if Aaron did?

cards.text: The LORD tells Moses why: "I appear in the cloud above the mercy seat." Friend, if that were me, my eyebrows would be SWEATING just walking past that veil.

So the LORD lays out exactly how Aaron enters, and this is NOT a recipe you wing. Aaron brings a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, and he wears holy linen garments: a tunic, undergarments, a sash and a turban.

cards.question: Aaron can put on the holy linen garments without bathing first.

cards.text: Then Aaron takes animals from the congregation of Israel: two male goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.

cards.question: Aaron presents the bull for his sin offering. Who does that bull make atonement for?

cards.text: Then Aaron presents the two goats before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and casts lots for them. One for the LORD, one for the scapegoat, and both goats looking at each other like, "Wait. Which one of us is which?"

cards.question: The goat chosen by lot for the LORD is sacrificed as a sin offering. The scapegoat is presented alive before the LORD. What happens to the scapegoat next?

answers.text: It is sent into the wilderness
It is sacrificed on the altar
It is kept at the Tent of Meeting

cards.text: Now Aaron slaughters the bull for his own sin offering. Then he takes a censer full of burning coals from the altar, plus two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense, and goes inside the veil.

cards.question: Aaron puts the incense on the fire before the LORD. The cloud of incense covers the ___ above the Testimony.
The cloud of incense is there so that Aaron will not die.

cards.text: Still behind the veil, Aaron sprinkles the bull's blood with his finger on the east side of the mercy seat, then seven times in front of it. Next, he slaughters the goat for the people's sin offering and brings its blood behind the veil too.

cards.question: What does Aaron do with the goat's blood behind the veil?

answers.text: He sprinkles it like the bull's blood
He pours it out beside the ark
He mixes it into the incense

cards.question: Aaron makes atonement for the Most Holy Place itself. What reason does the LORD give?

answers.text: The sins of the nations nearby
The sins of the people of Egypt

cards.text: Then he does the same for the Tent of Meeting, which abides among them in the midst of their impurities. Not across town from the mess, friend, RIGHT in the middle of it.
From the time Aaron goes in until he leaves, no one else may be in the Tent of Meeting. One man doing ALL of this, and Aaron's step counter is going THROUGH the roof, friend.

cards.question: By the time Aaron leaves the Tent of Meeting, he has made atonement only for the people, not for himself.

cards.text: Then Aaron goes out to the altar before the LORD. He puts some of the bull's blood and the goat's blood on all the horns of the altar and sprinkles it seven times.

cards.question: Aaron puts blood on the altar's horns and sprinkles it seven times. What is that for?

answers.text: To cleanse it from Israel's uncleanness
To mark it for the next high priest
To warn the people to stay back

cards.question: Aaron has purified the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting and the altar. Now he lays both hands on the live goat's head. What does he do next?

answers.text: He confesses all Israel's sins over it
He ties a scarlet cord on its horns
He anoints its head with oil

cards.text: Then the goat is sent away by the hand of a man appointed for the task, carrying all their iniquities into a solitary place in the wilderness. ALL of it on one goat, and I used to complain when somebody set a cookie box on top of me.
Then Aaron goes back into the Tent of Meeting, takes off the linen garments and leaves them there. He bathes in a holy place and puts his own clothes back on.

cards.question: Back in his own clothes, Aaron goes out to sacrifice. What does he offer now?

answers.text: His burnt offering and the people's
A second bull for the people
A lamb for the other priests

cards.text: He also burns the fat of the sin offering on the altar. Now, remember the man who walked the scapegoat out into the wilderness?

cards.question: What must the man who released the scapegoat do before he can come back into the camp?

answers.text: Bring an offering of his own

cards.text: The bull and the goat whose blood went into the Most Holy Place are taken outside the camp.

cards.question: Outside the camp, what happens to the bull and the goat for the sin offering?

answers.text: Everything left goes to the priests

cards.question: The one who burns the bull and the goat must also wash his clothes and bathe before he comes back into the camp.

cards.text: Then the LORD makes this a permanent statute, on the tenth day of the seventh month. Put it on the calendar, friend, and NO snooze button.

cards.question: On the tenth day of the seventh month, the people shall ___ themselves and not do any work.
The rules for the tenth day of the seventh month are only for native Israelites, not for the foreigners who reside among them.
Why is the tenth day of the seventh month such a big deal for Israel?

answers.text: Atonement will be made to cleanse them
It marks the day they left Egypt
It marks the end of the harvest

cards.text: The LORD calls it "a Sabbath of complete rest for you…" No oven, no timer, NOTHING, and my mustache wouldn't know what to do with itself.

cards.question: After Aaron, who will make atonement on the tenth day of the seventh month?

answers.text: The priest ordained to succeed his father
Whoever the elders of Israel choose
The oldest man from each tribe

cards.text: He puts on the sacred linen garments and makes atonement for the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting and the altar. And for the priests and all the people of the assembly.

cards.question: This permanent statute is to make atonement ___ a year for the Israelites because of all their sins.

cards.text: And then this: "And all this was done as the LORD had commanded Moses."
